headline: President Bush ordered the freezing of US-held property of people tied to the conflict in Sudan's Darfur region.
what_it_does: This executive order blocks, or freezes, property and assets in the United States that belong to certain people connected to the conflict in Darfur, Sudan. Under orders like this, people and companies in the US generally cannot do business with or transfer money to those listed. The title does not say who is named or how they are chosen.

who_it_affects.group: People linked to the Darfur conflict
who_it_affects.how: Any property or assets they hold under US control can be frozen.
They would generally be barred from dealing with the property of people covered by the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 26, 2006; the exact start date is not stated in the provided material.
